changes_made.explanation: Consolidated model names to standard forms, removed redundant size specifications, generalized output descriptions. Added GPT-3.5-turbo as evaluator model.
Normalized ROUGE-L to ROUGE base form, removed duplicate TTR entry. G-Eval is an LLM-judge metric, not traditional automatic metric.
Normalized model name and criteria. Methods and criteria correctly extracted from the detailed evaluation prompt provided.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. Only automatic metrics and LLM-based evaluation were used.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on language modeling and text generation tasks, using both traditional automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, etc.) and LLM-as-judge evaluation (G-Eval with GPT-3.5-turbo). No human evaluation was conducted. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and metric variants.
